title: HKUST Summer UG Research Program 2027
institution: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST)
about: The HKUST Summer UG Research Program 2027 in Hong Kong is an eight-week research placement for undergraduates at overseas, non-Chinese institutions, running 14 June to 6 August 2027. The online application opens in early January 2027 and closes 15 February 2027.
requirements: Full-time undergraduates at overseas, non-Chinese institutions
At least 2 years of study completed by the program start
Aged 18 or older by the start date

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: field "Undergraduate research placement" → objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
research placement → objective "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
